ext\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eBundle-local media file (screenshots, diagrams, video, PDF).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePOST\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__comment\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eUser's comment / threaded reply → \u003ccode\u003edirectives.jsonl\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePOST\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__comment-update\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eUser-facing state/archive transition, or a body edit of a not-yet-resolved comment.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePOST\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__presence\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eAgent presence (idle/watching/thinking/editing) + optional progress \u003ccode\u003emessage\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePOST\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__apply\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eRun a whitelisted \u003ccode\u003eUpdateOp\u003c/code\u003e via the studio write funnel.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePOST\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__undo\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eRestore a prior snapshot (single or group).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePOST\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__preview\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eRender arbitrary in-flight markdown.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePOST\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__tunnel\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eServer admin: attach/detach/status a cloudflared quick tunnel at runtime.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eRouting normalises a trailing slash (except root) and a trailing \u003ccode\u003e.md\u003c/code\u003e on concept routes (except \u003ccode\u003e/index.md\u003c/code\u003e and \u003ccode\u003e\u0026lt;dir\u0026gt;/index.md\u003c/code\u003e, which are reserved). So \u003ccode\u003e/tables/customers.md\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003e/tables/customers\u003c/code\u003e, and \u003ccode\u003e/tables/customers/\u003c/code\u003e all resolve to the same concept page.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"authentication-model\"\u003eAuthentication model\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eSurface\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eGuard\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003eEvery GET\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eNone (loopback bind by default).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eGET /__diff\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePer-session CSRF token (\u003ccode\u003eX-OKF-Token\u003c/code\u003e).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003eEvery POST\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePer-session CSRF token \u003cstrong\u003eAND\u003c/strong\u003e Origin/Host ∈ \u003ccode\u003estudio.allowed_hosts\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe token is generated on \u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom serve\u003c/code\u003e boot, written to \u003ccode\u003e\u0026lt;bundle\u0026gt;/.okf-loom/session/.token\u003c/code\u003e (mode \u003ccode\u003e0600\u003c/code\u003e), embedded in every served HTML page (CSP-safe JSON data block), and read by the studio client which attaches it as \u003ccode\u003eX-OKF-Token\u003c/code\u003e on every write. \u003ca href=\"cli.md#token\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom token \u0026lt;bundle\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e prints it for direct HTTP use; the CLI mutators attach it automatically.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ccode\u003eallowed_hosts\u003c/code\u003e defaults to \u003ccode\u003e(\"127.0.0.1\", \"localhost\")\u003c/code\u003e and is never empty (fail-closed). A \u003ccode\u003euser\u003c/code\u003e actor's presence write only takes effect when the current agent presence is already \u003ccode\u003eidle\u003c/code\u003e or \u003ccode\u003ewatching\u003c/code\u003e, so a browser boot cannot clobber an active agent.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ccode\u003e--no-edit\u003c/code\u003e flips the studio into a read-only kiosk: live reads stay on, every POST returns \u003ccode\u003e403\u003c/code\u003e — except \u003ccode\u003e/__tunnel\u003c/code\u003e, which is server admin (not a bundle write; sharing a read-only kiosk is its use case) and stays available. It is never exempt from the token + Origin/Host guard.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"get-routes\"\u003eGET routes\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"section\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eRoot index page. Renders the bundle-root \u003ccode\u003eindex.md\u003c/code\u003e (hand-authored or generated) plus the type-grouped concept listing. The studio bootstrap (token + asset links) is injected into the \u003ccode\u003e\u0026lt;/head\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"concept-id\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/\u0026lt;concept_id\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eConcept page. \u003ccode\u003econcept_id\u003c/code\u003e is the dotted path without \u003ccode\u003e.md\u003c/code\u003e (e.g. \u003ccode\u003e/tables/orders\u003c/code\u003e). Returns 404 for an unknown concept unless the path matches a directory containing concepts, in which case it falls back to the directory index page.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe page carries: rendered body HTML, frontmatter, the \"Cited by\" backlinks panel, outgoing links, and a local-graph widget.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"dir\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/\u0026lt;dir\u0026gt;/\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eDirectory index page for the subdirectory \u003ccode\u003e\u0026lt;dir\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e. Renders the \u003ccode\u003e\u0026lt;dir\u0026gt;/index.md\u003c/code\u003e if present, else a generated listing. Path segments are validated; \u003ccode\u003e..\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003e.\u003c/code\u003e, and NUL bytes return 404.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"graph\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__graph\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFull-page Cytoscape.js force-directed graph of the whole bundle. The graph data comes from \u003ccode\u003e/__data/graph.json\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"search\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__search\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-http\"\u003eGET /__search?q=customer\u0026amp;format=json\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eQuery param\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eEffect\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eq\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eThe query string. Capped at \u003ccode\u003eMAX_SEARCH_QUERY_CHARS\u003c/code\u003e; over-long queries are truncated, not rejected.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eformat\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003ehtml\u003c/code\u003e (default) or \u003ccode\u003ejson\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe HTTP path always uses the lexical backend with a limit of \u003ccode\u003e30\u003c/code\u003e. For the other five modes use the CLI. JSON shape matches the \u003ccode\u003eSearchResult\u003c/code\u003e shape in \u003ca href=\"search_modes.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003esearch_modes.md § Result shape\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"rawconcept-id\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__raw/\u0026lt;concept_id\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eRaw markdown body of one concept (\u003ccode\u003eContent-Type: text/markdown\u003c/code\u003e). Used by popover previews and agent copy/paste. Returns 413 if the body exceeds \u003ccode\u003eMAX_RAW_RESPONSE_BYTES\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"datagraphjson\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__data/graph.json\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eGraph JSON: nodes (one per concept) + edges (one per internal link, including wikilinks with \u003ccode\u003eform=\"wikilink\"\u003c/code\u003e). Same shape as \u003ca href=\"cli.md#graph\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003egraph --format json\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"datacontentjson\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__data/content.json\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFull content index JSON: every concept's id, type, title, description, tags, and outgoing link targets. Same shape as the \u003ccode\u003e.okf-loom/index/content.json\u003c/code\u003e derived artifact emitted by \u003ca href=\"cli.md#index\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003eindex --emit-json\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"datadocidconcept-id\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__data/doc?id=\u0026lt;concept_id\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eOne concept's rendered + raw + metadata JSON for in-place re-render (the §6 no-refresh live update path).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-json\"\u003e{\n  \"id\": \"tables/orders\",\n  \"rev\": \"\u0026lt;content-hash\u0026gt;\",\n  \"title\": \"Orders\",\n  \"type\": \"Table\",\n  \"html\": \"\u0026lt;rendered body HTML\u0026gt;\",\n  \"raw\": \"\u0026lt;raw markdown body\u0026gt;\",\n  \"frontmatter\": { \"type\": \"Table\", \"title\": \"Orders\", \"...\" : \"...\" },\n  \"headings\": [{\"level\": 1, \"text\": \"Schema\"}, \"...\"],\n  \"backlinks\": [\"services/checkout\"],\n  \"outgoing\": [\"tables/customers\", \"tables/products\"]\n}\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eReturns 400 if \u003ccode\u003eid\u003c/code\u003e is absent, 404 if the id is malformed or unknown.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"dataevents\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__data/events\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-http\"\u003eGET /__data/events?since=\u0026lt;id\u0026gt;\u0026amp;limit=200\u0026amp;actor=agent\u0026amp;concept=tables/orders\u0026amp;order=desc\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFiltered read of \u003ccode\u003eevents.jsonl\u003c/code\u003e for the change list. Defaults to newest-first; \u003ccode\u003e?order=asc\u003c/code\u003e opts into oldest-first (used by \u003ca href=\"cli.md#watch\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom watch --since\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e replay).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-json\"\u003e{ \"events\": [ /* §7.2 schema rows */ ], \"rev\": \"\u0026lt;current bundle rev\u0026gt;\" }\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"events\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__events\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSSE stream (\u003ccode\u003etext/event-stream\u003c/code\u003e). One event per change/presence/activity/comment event. 15-second heartbeat (\u003ccode\u003etype=ping\u003c/code\u003e). Capped at \u003ccode\u003estudio.max_sse_clients\u003c/code\u003e concurrent streams (default \u003ccode\u003e32\u003c/code\u003e); returns 503 when full or when the studio is absent / \u003ccode\u003e--no-watch-ui\u003c/code\u003e is set.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eFrame type\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eCarries\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eready\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eInitial frame: \u003ccode\u003erev\u003c/code\u003e + per-doc rev map (\u003ccode\u003edoc_revs\u003c/code\u003e).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003echanged\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003ecreated\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003eremoved\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eA concept mutation (debounced).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003egraph\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eA graph-affecting mutation (re-fetch the graph).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003epresence\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eAgent presence state change.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003ecomment\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eA comment directive was appended or transitioned. Carries \u003ccode\u003eactor\u003c/code\u003e, plus \u003ccode\u003eparent_id\u003c/code\u003e when the comment is a reply, so a tab that did not post the reply still threads it under its parent.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003ecomment_link\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eA resolve back-stamped an activity event.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eping\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eHeartbeat.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eresync\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eServer instructs client to refetch (rev + per-doc rev map).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ccode\u003eX-Accel-Buffering: no\u003c/code\u003e is sent so buffering proxies do not stall the stream. A HEAD request to \u003ccode\u003e/__events\u003c/code\u003e returns an empty body immediately (it must not enter the SSE loop).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"comments\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__comments\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-http\"\u003eGET /__comments?state=open\u0026amp;concept=tables/orders\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eCanonical comment state from \u003ccode\u003edirectives.jsonl\u003c/code\u003e (last-write-wins per id). The studio client consumes this directly rather than reconstructing from the event feed. Each row carries \u003ccode\u003earchived\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003esummary\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003ets\u003c/code\u003e, and \u003ccode\u003eupdated_at\u003c/code\u003e. See \u003ca href=\"comment_lifecycle.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003ecomment_lifecycle.md\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-json\"\u003e{ \"comments\": [ /* see comment_lifecycle.md § JSON shape */ ] }\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"diff\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__diff\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-http\"\u003eGET /__diff?concept=tables/orders\u0026amp;from=\u0026lt;rev\u0026gt;\u0026amp;to=\u0026lt;rev\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eLine diff between two revs of one concept. Requires the CSRF token (because it exposes prior snapshot bytes). Returns 400 if any of \u003ccode\u003econcept\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003efrom\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eto\u003c/code\u003e is missing; 404 if either snapshot is missing.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-json\"\u003e{\n  \"ok\": true,\n  \"concept\": \"tables/orders\",\n  \"from\": \"\u0026lt;rev\u0026gt;\",\n  \"to\": \"\u0026lt;rev\u0026gt;\",\n  \"diff\": [\n    {\"kind\": \"ctx\", \"num\": 12, \"text\": \"...\"},\n    {\"kind\": \"del\", \"num\": 13, \"text\": \"...\"},\n    {\"kind\": \"add\", \"num\": 13, \"text\": \"...\"}\n  ]\n}\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"staticfile\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__static/\u0026lt;file\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eStatic assets (JS modules, CSS). Bundle overrides under \u003ccode\u003e.okf-loom/viewer/static/\u0026lt;file\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e are served first \u003cstrong\u003eonly\u003c/strong\u003e when the active-code gate is open (bundle declares \u003ccode\u003eviewer.allow_active_code: true\u003c/code\u003e AND operator consent via \u003ccode\u003e--allow-active-code\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003eOKF_LOOM_ALLOW_ACTIVE_CODE\u003c/code\u003e). Path traversal is rejected (\u003ccode\u003e..\u003c/code\u003e and separators after normalisation; NUL bytes).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCache-busting.\u003c/strong\u003e Every external asset URL the viewer emits into live, SPA, and static-build HTML carries a content-derived \u003ccode\u003e?v=\u0026lt;16-hex\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e query — the first 16 hex chars of the SHA-256 of the resolved asset content (builtin or effective override). Same content yields the same version deterministically across runs and machines; any content change yields a different version, so browsers and CDNs fetch fresh bytes after an edit. The query is \u003cstrong\u003eignored for routing\u003c/strong\u003e (the live server routes on the path component, static webservers ignore query strings on files), so a versioned URL and the plain URL resolve to the identical bytes. The single-file viewer inlines its CSS/JS and carries no version query. The version is a pure function of the resolved bytes — no per-process timestamp or random salt — so it is identical across the live, SPA, and static emit paths.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"pathmedia-ext\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/\u0026lt;path\u0026gt;.\u0026lt;media ext\u0026gt;\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eBundle-local media file, so \u003ccode\u003e![shot](/research/assets/shot.png)\u003c/code\u003e renders inline in the studio. Only paths whose extension is in the media allowlist route here — everything else stays a concept path. A media-suffixed path that names no existing file falls through to concept routing (\u003ccode\u003eshot.png.md\u003c/code\u003e is a legal concept rendering at \u003ccode\u003e/shot.png\u003c/code\u003e); when both exist, the file wins.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable group.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eResponse \u003ccode\u003e200 OK\u003c/code\u003e:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-json\"\u003e{ \"ok\": true, \"restored\": 3 }\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSpecial cases:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eCase\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eResponse\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003eEvery target already at its snapshot rev (replay)\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e409\u003c/code\u003e \u003ccode\u003e{ok:false, conflict:true, error:\"already_undone\", targets, current_state}\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003eEvery snapshot pruned by the history ring cap\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e404\u003c/code\u003e \u003ccode\u003e{ok:false, error:\"snapshots_pruned\", missing}\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003eSome targets pruned, some restored\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e409\u003c/code\u003e \u003ccode\u003e{ok:true, restored:N, partial:true, missing}\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"preview\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__preview\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eRender arbitrary in-flight markdown (DoS-capped).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-json\"\u003e{ \"markdown\": \"# Hello\\n\\n**bold** text\" }\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-json\"\u003e{ \"ok\": true, \"html\": \"\u0026lt;h1\u0026gt;Hello\u0026lt;/h1\u0026gt;\u0026lt;p\u0026gt;\u0026lt;strong\u0026gt;bold\u0026lt;/strong\u0026gt; text\u0026lt;/p\u0026gt;\" }\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"tunnel\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/__tunnel\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eServer admin: attach/detach a cloudflared quick tunnel on the RUNNING server, so going public does not mean restarting \u003ccode\u003eserve\u003c/code\u003e (losing the session token, open SSE clients, and undo history). Driven by \u003ca href=\"cli.md#tunnel\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom tunnel\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e. Exempt from \u003ccode\u003e--no-edit\u003c/code\u003e kiosk mode (server admin, not a bundle write) but never from the token + Origin/Host guard.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-json\"\u003e{ \"action\": \"start\" }\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eAction\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eResponse\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003estart\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e200\u003c/code\u003e \u003ccode\u003e{ok: true, url}\u003c/code\u003e; \u003ccode\u003e{ok, url, already_running: true}\u003c/code\u003e when a tunnel is already up (idempotent); \u003ccode\u003e502\u003c/code\u003e \u003ccode\u003e{ok:false, error}\u003c/code\u003e when \u003ccode\u003ecloudflared\u003c/code\u003e is missing or times out.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003estop\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e200\u003c/code\u003e \u003ccode\u003e{ok: true, url: null, stopped: bool}\u003c/code\u003e (idempotent).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003estatus\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e200\u003c/code\u003e \u003ccode\u003e{ok: true, url}\u003c/code\u003e (\u003ccode\u003eurl\u003c/code\u003e is \u003ccode\u003enull\u003c/code\u003e when no tunnel is up).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAny other \u003ccode\u003eaction\u003c/code\u003e returns \u003ccode\u003e400\u003c/code\u003e. \u003ccode\u003estart\u003c/code\u003e adds the tunnel hostname to the per-request \u003ccode\u003eallowed_hosts\u003c/code\u003e immediately and records the URL in \u003ccode\u003e\u0026lt;session\u0026gt;/server.json\u003c/code\u003e; \u003ccode\u003estop\u003c/code\u003e restores the pre-tunnel allowlist. The tunnel process belongs to the serve process and dies with it.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"response-shapes-common-conventions\"\u003eResponse shapes (common conventions)\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eStatus\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eBody\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e200\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003e201\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eJSON \u003ccode\u003e{ok: true, ...}\u003c/code\u003e or HTML/text.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e400\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eJSON \u003ccode\u003e{ok:false, error:\"…\"}\u003c/code\u003e with a stable reason prefix.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e403\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePlain text. Cross-origin guard failure or read-only kiosk.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e404\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePlain text \u003ccode\u003eNot found\u003c/code\u003e / JSON \u003ccode\u003e{ok:false, error:\"…\"}\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e409\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eJSON \u003ccode\u003e{ok:false, ...}\u003c/code\u003e (conflict, dismiss-on-claimed, unresolved-thread archive, etc.).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e413\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePlain text. Oversized body; connection closed.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e500\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePlain text \u003ccode\u003eInternal Server Error\u003c/code\u003e. Full traceback logged to stderr only (no info disclosure).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e502\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eJSON \u003ccode\u003e{ok:false, error:\"…\"}\u003c/code\u003e. Tunnel start failed (\u003ccode\u003ecloudflared\u003c/code\u003e missing or timed out).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e503\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePlain text. Studio absent, SSE full, or \u003ccode\u003e--no-watch-ui\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"embedding-the-server\"\u003eEmbedding the server\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-python\"\u003efrom http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer\nfrom okf_loom import Bundle\nfrom okf_loom.server import OKFWikiHandler\n\nbundle = Bundle.load(\"path/to/bundle\")\nhttpd = ThreadingHTTPServer((\"127.0.0.1\", 8787), OKFWikiHandler)\nhttpd.bundle = bundle         # attribute the handler reads\n# httpd.studio = Studio(...)  # attach for the live studio (optional)\nhttpd.serve_forever()\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eRun it in a daemon thread inside another agent process; the bundle can be swapped at runtime (\u003ccode\u003ehttpd.bundle = Bundle.load(...)\u003c/code\u003e). "reference/links": "\u003ch2 id=\"link-forms\"\u003eLink forms\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eConcepts cross-link with standard markdown links. The link graph is what turns a tree of files into a knowledge graph: links are the edges, concepts are the nodes, and the \u003ca href=\"cli.md#graph\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003egraph view\u003c/a\u003e + \u003ca href=\"capabilities.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003ebacklinks panel\u003c/a\u003e are the navigable surfaces built on top.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eOKF supports two link forms (SPEC §5). Both are valid; okf-loom handles both in its validator, viewer, search, and graph. See \u003ca href=\"/reference/index.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003eindex.md\u003c/a\u003e for the rest of the reference quadrant.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"the-two-forms\"\u003eThe two forms\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eForm\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eSyntax\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eSPEC\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eStability\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAbsolute bundle-relative\u003c/strong\u003e (recommended)\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e[label](/tables/customers.md)\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e§5.1\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eStable when files move within a subdirectory.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eRelative\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e[label](./customers.md)\u003c/code\u003e or \u003ccode\u003e[label](../parent/thing.md)\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e§5.2\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eStable only for tightly-coupled siblings that always move together.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eBoth forms resolve to the same target concept id; the graph treats them identically.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eokf-loom fixes an upstream bug where the reference viewer silently dropped absolute links, producing incomplete graphs. Absolute is the recommended form for new authoring.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"absolute-bundle-relative-51\"\u003eAbsolute bundle-relative (§5.1)\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eA leading \u003ccode\u003e/\u003c/code\u003e makes the path bundle-relative. The path is the concept file's path from the bundle root.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-markdown\"\u003eThe order's customer is in [customers](/tables/customers.md).\nSee also the [checkout service](/services/checkout.md).\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eUse this form by default. It stays correct when a file moves within its subdirectory (e.g. \u003ccode\u003etables/customers.md\u003c/code\u003e → \u003ccode\u003etables/v2/customers.md\u003c/code\u003e would need a path update, but \u003ccode\u003etables/orders.md\u003c/code\u003e → \u003ccode\u003etables/v2/orders.md\u003c/code\u003e leaves the link from \u003ccode\u003eservices/checkout.md\u003c/code\u003e intact).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"relative-52\"\u003eRelative (§5.2)\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eNo leading \u003ccode\u003e/\u003c/code\u003e; resolves against the linking file's directory.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-markdown\"\u003eThe next concept is [orders](./orders.md).\nThe parent is [tables](../index.md).\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eUse only for tightly-coupled siblings that always move together.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"anchors\"\u003eAnchors\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eBoth forms support same-document and cross-document anchors:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-markdown\"\u003e# Same-document anchor\nSee the [schema section](#schema).\n\n# Cross-document anchor\nFK to [customers](/tables/customers.md#schema).\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAnchors are derived from heading text via slugify. They are not graph edges; they are intra-document or intra-concept navigation.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"external-links\"\u003eExternal links\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eLinks whose scheme is \u003ccode\u003ehttp\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003ehttps\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003emailto\u003c/code\u003e, etc. are external. okf-loom keeps them, classifies them as external, and does NOT add them as graph edges.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-markdown\"\u003eSpec: [current okf-loom spec](/reference/spec.md).\nContact: [data team](mailto:data@example.com).\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe validator emits an INFO finding (\u003ccode\u003elink.external\u003c/code\u003e) for each external link so they are countable but not promoted to errors.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"wikilinks-spec-10\"\u003eWikilinks (SPEC §10)\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eObsidian-style wikilinks are recognised as body syntax (no frontmatter key required). They auto-activate the \u003ccode\u003eokf.cap.wikilinks\u003c/code\u003e capability (see \u003ca href=\"capabilities.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003ecapabilities.md\u003c/a\u003e).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-markdown\"\u003e[[tables/customers]]\n[[tables/customers|Customer]]\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe link extractor resolves wikilinks to concept ids and emits them as graph edges with \u003ccode\u003eform=\"wikilink\"\u003c/code\u003e (visible in \u003ccode\u003egraph --format json\u003c/code\u003e and the viewer). The validator emits an INFO finding (\u003ccode\u003elink.wikilink_present\u003c/code\u003e) suggesting conversion to standard markdown links for portability.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe §8 mutator verbs (\u003ca href=\"cli.md#write-concept\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003ewrite-concept\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e, \u003ca href=\"cli.md#link-add\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003elink-add\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e, etc.) always emit standard markdown links, never wikilinks. The recommended authoring form is therefore absolute bundle-relative markdown links; wikilinks are tolerated for Obsidian/Quartz interop.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"broken-link-tolerance-spec-53\"\u003eBroken-link tolerance (SPEC §5.3)\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eA link whose target does not exist is \u003cstrong\u003enot malformed\u003c/strong\u003e. It may be not-yet-written knowledge. okf-loom surfaces broken links as \u003ccode\u003eWARNING\u003c/code\u003e findings (\u003ccode\u003elink.broken\u003c/code\u003e), never as errors.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-markdown\"\u003eWe will add [returns](/tables/returns.md) soon — the link is valid\nOKF even though `tables/returns.md` does not yet exist.\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThis is the SPEC §5.3 contract: link aggressively to forthcoming concepts. The link becomes a real edge the moment you create the target file.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"forward-references\"\u003eForward references\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ca href=\"cli.md#link-add\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom link-add --allow-forward-reference\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e writes a link whose target does not yet exist. The link is written in the absolute form and is \u003ccode\u003ebroken\u003c/code\u003e (WARNING) until the target concept is created.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"code-blocks-and-inline-code\"\u003eCode blocks and inline code\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eMarkdown links inside fenced code blocks or inline code are NOT counted as graph edges. The viewer will not navigate them.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-markdown\"\u003eThe literal path `/tables/users.md` is shown to the reader but is\nnot a graph edge because it is in inline code.\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"where-to-put-links\"\u003eWhere to put links\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn the \u003cstrong\u003ebody prose\u003c/strong\u003e, where the relationship is asserted. A common pattern is the \u003ccode\u003e# Schema\u003c/code\u003e table where foreign-key columns link to their target concept:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-markdown\"\u003e# Schema\n\n| Column | Type | Description |\n|---|---|---|\n| `customer_id` | STRING | FK to [customers](/tables/customers.md). |\n| `product_id` | STRING | FK to [products](/tables/products.md). |\n\n# Joins\n\nJoined with [customers](/tables/customers.md) on `customer_id` to\nenrich orders with user geography.\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe discovery pass (\u003ca href=\"cli.md#discover\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom discover --rules unlinked_mentions\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e) flags mentions of a concept's title that appear in body prose without a link; those are candidates for \u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom link-add\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"how-the-viewer-routes-links\"\u003eHow the viewer routes links\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe live studio (\u003ca href=\"cli.md#serve\" class=\"okf-external\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" target=\"_blank\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom serve\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e) normalises both link forms to the same canonical route:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eLink\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eRoute\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/tables/customers.md\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/tables/customers\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/tables/customers\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/tables/customers\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e./customers.md\u003c/code\u003e (from \u003ccode\u003etables/orders.md\u003c/code\u003e)\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e/tables/customers\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe route layer strips a trailing \u003ccode\u003e.md\u003c/code\u003e (except for the reserved \u003ccode\u003e/index.md\u003c/code\u003e routes) and a trailing slash (except for root). contract.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e", "reference/search_modes": "\u003ch2 id=\"search-modes\"\u003eSearch modes\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eokf-loom's \u003ccode\u003esearch\u003c/code\u003e command and the live studio's \u003ccode\u003e/__search\u003c/code\u003e endpoint dispatch to one of six modes behind a single \u003ccode\u003e--mode\u003c/code\u003e flag. \u003cstrong\u003eAll six modes are dependency-free\u003c/strong\u003e out of the box: lexical (BM25), semantic (fuzzy-semantic SemanticLite), and hybrid (RRF fusion of the two) require no extra packages. See \u003ca href=\"/reference/index.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003eindex.md\u003c/a\u003e for the rest of the reference quadrant.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"mode-summary\"\u003eMode summary\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eMode\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eBackend\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eWhat it ranks by\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eActivate\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003elexical\u003c/code\u003e (default)\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eLexicalBackend\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eField-weighted BM25 (title 5× \u0026gt; headings 3× \u0026gt; description 2× \u0026gt; body 1× \u0026gt; tags membership (case-insensitive); ties broken by title.\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eAlways.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003esemantic\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eSemanticLiteBackend\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eFuzzy-semantic \u003ccode\u003eα=0.6\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eAlways.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003ehybrid\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eHybridBackend\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eReciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60) of lexical ∪ semantic-lite.\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eActivates \u003ccode\u003eokf.cap.search_hybrid\u003c/code\u003e on first successful match.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eentity\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e(in-module)\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eMatch against concept id, keys are present.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003erelation\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e(in-module)\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eFilter \u003ccode\u003e--target\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eActivates \u003ccode\u003eokf.cap.typed_relations\u003c/code\u003e when \u003ccode\u003erelations:\u003c/code\u003e is present.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAll modes accept the cross-cutting filters \u003ccode\u003e--type TYPE\u003c/code\u003e and \u003ccode\u003e--tag TAG\u003c/code\u003e (applied as post-filters).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"lexical-bm25\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003elexical\u003c/code\u003e — BM25\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003ePure-Python BM25 with field weighting. Default mode. Zero deps.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"customer order\"\nscripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"user\" --type \"API Endpoint\"\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"scoring\"\u003eScoring\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFor query terms \u003ccode\u003et\u003c/code\u003e in field \u003ccode\u003ef\u003c/code\u003e of document \u003ccode\u003ed\u003c/code\u003e:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode\u003eidf(t, f)     = ln( (N - df(t, f) + 0.5) / (df(t, f) + 0.5) + 1 )\nbm25(t, d, f) = idf(t, f) * ( tf(t, d, f) * (k1 + 1) )\n                                / ( tf(t, d, f) + k1 * (1 - b + b * dl(d, f) / avgdl(f)) )\nbm25(q, d, f) = Σ_t bm25(t, d, f)\nscore(q, d)   = Σ_f weight(f) * bm25(q, d, f)\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eSymbol\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eDefault\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eMeaning\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003ek1\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e1.5\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eTerm-frequency saturation.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eb\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e0.75\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eLength normalisation.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eN\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ecorpus size\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eTotal number of concepts.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eweight(f)\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003etitle 5.0, headings 3.0, description 2.0, body 1.0, tags 1.0\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eField weight.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe \u003ccode\u003e+1\u003c/code\u003e inside the \u003ccode\u003eidf\u003c/code\u003e log keeps idf strictly positive (the standard variant).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"determinism\"\u003eDeterminism\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eDocuments are scored in sorted concept-id order and the final ranking tie-breaks by concept id. The same \u003ccode\u003e(bundle, query)\u003c/code\u003e always yields the same ordering.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"tokenisation\"\u003eTokenisation\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eLowercase, split on Unicode word boundaries, drop a small English stopword set, split CJK runs into single-character tokens (so \u003ccode\u003e比特币\u003c/code\u003e indexes as \u003ccode\u003e[\"比\", \"特\", \"币\"]\u003c/code\u003e).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"tag-tag-membership\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003etag\u003c/code\u003e — tag membership\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"#sales\" --mode tag\nscripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"sales\" --mode tag\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eMatches \u003ccode\u003eConcept.tags\u003c/code\u003e case-insensitively. Sorted by title. The \u003ccode\u003e#\u003c/code\u003e prefix is optional. Every hit carries a constant \u003ccode\u003escore=1.0\u003c/code\u003e plus \u003ccode\u003ematched_tags\u003c/code\u003e listing the subset of the concept's own tags that matched.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"semantic-semanticlite\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003esemantic\u003c/code\u003e — SemanticLite\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"customer order\" --mode semantic\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eNot embeddings.\u003c/strong\u003e Combines token-level TF cosine with character-trigram TF cosine over a weighted per-concept profile.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eComponent\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eDetail\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003eToken cosine\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eShares the lexical tokenizer; rewards shared domain terms.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003eTrigram cosine\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eRobust to typos and morphology (\u003ccode\u003eorders\u003c/code\u003e ≈ \u003ccode\u003eorder\u003c/code\u003e).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003eProfile string\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003etitle ×3 + description ×2 + type + headings + tags + entity labels + aliases\u003c/code\u003e (the last two only if \u003ccode\u003eokf.cap.entities\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003eokf.cap.aliases\u003c/code\u003e are active).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003eScore\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eα * cosine(tokens) + (1-α) * cosine(trigrams)\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eα=0.6\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSemanticLite is the cheap fuzzy-semantic layer that helps an agent find candidate concepts. The agent itself (an LLM in opencode / Claude Code / Codex) is the best true-semantic engine, so a local embedding backend would be redundant.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"hybrid-rrf-fusion\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003ehybrid\u003c/code\u003e — RRF fusion\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"customer order\" --mode hybrid\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eReciprocal Rank Fusion of \u003ccode\u003eLexicalBackend\u003c/code\u003e and \u003ccode\u003eSemanticLiteBackend\u003c/code\u003e, both zero-dep.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode\u003errf(d) = Σ_backend 1 / (k + rank_backend(d))    with k = 60\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eConcepts missing from a backend contribute 0 from that backend. Sort by \u003ccode\u003e(-rrf, concept_id)\u003c/code\u003e. A successful hybrid query (at least one match) activates \u003ccode\u003eokf.cap.search_hybrid\u003c/code\u003e for the bundle.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"entity-entityalias-match\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003eentity\u003c/code\u003e — entity/alias match\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"order\" --mode entity\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eMatch against concept id, title, description, entity labels, and aliases. Honours \u003ccode\u003eokf.cap.entities\u003c/code\u003e (the \u003ccode\u003eentities:\u003c/code\u003e frontmatter key) and \u003ccode\u003eokf.cap.aliases\u003c/code\u003e (the top-level \u003ccode\u003ealiases:\u003c/code\u003e key). Useful for \"what concept represents this business term?\" lookups when synonyms and aliases matter.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"relation-typed-relation-graph-edge-filter\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003erelation\u003c/code\u003e — typed-relation / graph-edge filter\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"\" --mode relation --relation depends_on\nscripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"\" --mode relation --source tables/orders\nscripts/okf-loom search path/to/bundle \"\" --mode relation --relation writes_to --target tables/orders\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFilter typed-relation declarations (\u003ccode\u003erelations:\u003c/code\u003e frontmatter key) plus markdown graph edges. The query string is optional when at least one of \u003ccode\u003e--relation\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003e--source\u003c/code\u003e, or \u003ccode\u003e--target\u003c/code\u003e is supplied. Honours \u003ccode\u003eokf.cap.typed_relations\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eFlag\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eEffect\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e--relation TYPE\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eKeep only edges of this relation type.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e--source ID\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eKeep only edges whose source concept id matches.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e--target ID\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eKeep only edges whose target concept id matches.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"cross-cutting-filters\"\u003eCross-cutting filters\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eFlag\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eApplies to\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eBehaviour\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e--type TYPE\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eEvery mode\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eKeep only concepts whose \u003ccode\u003etype\u003c/code\u003e equals this string (exact match).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e--tag TAG\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eEvery mode\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eKeep only concepts carrying this tag (case-insensitive).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003e--limit N\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eEvery mode\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eMaximum number of results (default \u003ccode\u003e20\u003c/code\u003e).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"result-shape\"\u003eResult shape\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-json\"\u003e{\n  \"concept_id\": \"tables/orders\",\n  \"title\": \"Orders\",\n  \"score\": 12.41,\n  \"snippets\": [\"…one row per completed customer order…\"],\n  \"source_backend\": \"lexical\",\n  \"matched_tags\": [],\n  \"description\": \"One row per completed customer order.\"\n}\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eField\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eNotes\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003econcept_id\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eThe dotted path with \u003ccode\u003e.md\u003c/code\u003e stripped (e.g. \u003ccode\u003etables/orders\u003c/code\u003e).\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003etitle\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eBack-filled from the content index if the backend emitted a placeholder.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003escore\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eBackend-specific. Tag-mode results carry \u003ccode\u003e1.0\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003esnippets\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e0..N ~120-char excerpts centred on first matches, ellipsized.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003esource_backend\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003elexical\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003esemantic-lite\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003ehybrid\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003etag\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003ematched_tags\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePopulated in tag mode; empty otherwise.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003edescription\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eBack-filled from the content index for richer result context.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"searchbackend-protocol\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003eSearchBackend\u003c/code\u003e Protocol\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-python\"\u003e@runtime_checkable\nclass SearchBackend(Protocol):\n    name: str\n    def index(self, content_index: ContentIndex) -\u0026gt; None: ...\n    def search(self, query: str, *, limit: int) -\u0026gt; list[SearchResult]: ...\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eA backend indexes the canonical \u003ccode\u003eContentIndex\u003c/code\u003e once and answers ranked queries. \u003ccode\u003ename\u003c/code\u003e identifies the backend on \u003ccode\u003eSearchResult\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eBackends consume the canonical \u003ca href=\"/reference/architecture.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003eContentIndex\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e (the Quartz \"one model\" pattern) so search, graph, and listings all read the same object.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"caching\"\u003eCaching\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eEvery backend (lexical, semantic-lite) is cached on the \u003ccode\u003eBundle\u003c/code\u003e instance itself. The cache is released when the bundle is GC'd and is reset by \u003ccode\u003eBundle.invalidate()\u003c/code\u003e. In a long-running server that reloads bundles, reload the bundle (or call \u003ccode\u003ebundle.invalidate()\u003c/code\u003e) to evict.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ccode\u003eokf_loom.search.clear_search_cache()\u003c/code\u003e is retained as a deprecated no-op for backward compatibility.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"http-entry-point\"\u003eHTTP entry point\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe live studio exposes search at \u003ccode\u003eGET /__search?q=…\u003c/code\u003e (HTML) and \u003ccode\u003eGET /__search?q=…\u0026amp;format=json\u003c/code\u003e (JSON). The HTTP path always uses the lexical backend with a limit of \u003ccode\u003e30\u003c/code\u003e; for other modes use the CLI. See \u003ca href=\"http_routes.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003ehttp_routes.md\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"defaults\"\u003eDefaults\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe bundle-root \u003ca href=\"config_yaml.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003eokf-loom.config.yaml\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/a\u003e \u003ccode\u003esearch.default_mode\u003c/code\u003e key selects the mode used when no \u003ccode\u003e--mode\u003c/code\u003e is passed. Default is \u003ccode\u003elexical\u003c/code\u003e; allowed values are the six mode names (fail-closed on unknown values).\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch2 id=\"when-to-use-which-mode\"\u003eWhen to use which mode\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003ctable id=\"okf-loom-current-specification\"\u003eokf-loom Current Specification\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThis is the canonical current specification for the okf-loom v1.0 baseline. It describes current behavior directly rather than as a release-history delta. The authoritative runtime version is whatever \u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom --version\u003c/code\u003e prints; the v1.0 baseline reports \u003ccode\u003eokf-loom 1.0.0 (SPEC v0.1)\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe base OKF wire format remains upstream \u003cstrong\u003eOKF SPEC v0.1\u003c/strong\u003e. okf-loom constant remains \u003ccode\u003eSPEC_VERSION = \"0.1\"\u003c/code\u003e; the product/runtime version lives in \u003ccode\u003eokf_loom.LOOM_VERSION\u003c/code\u003e. okf-loom features are compatible optional capabilities layered on top of that v0.1 Markdown-plus-frontmatter format.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"1-primary-distribution-and-use-model\"\u003e1. Primary distribution and use model\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eokf-loom is currently distributed primarily as a GitHub-hosted, cloneable source repository. The primary use case is for an agent or harness to clone the repository, load the root \u003ccode\u003eSKILL.md\u003c/code\u003e, read focused resources under \u003ccode\u003eresources/\u003c/code\u003e, and run from the checkout.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe agent-facing skill resources are:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eResource\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eUse\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eSKILL.md\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePrimary loadable skill entrypoint.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eresources/format-basics.md\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eRead, validate, and edit one concept or learn the base format.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eresources/authoring.md\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eAuthor good concepts, links, indexes, logs, and frontmatter.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eresources/advanced-operations.md\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eOperate search, discover/plan/update, capabilities, and builds.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eresources/studio-agent-loop.md\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eOperate the live studio and comment loop.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe portable command form is source-checkout invocation:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003eokf-loom/scripts/okf-loom \u0026lt;command\u0026gt; ...\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhen already inside the repository root, use:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom validate docs-bundle --strict\nscripts/okf-loom serve docs-bundle --no-open\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eUse the checked-in helper directly; do not assume an installed console script or package. The primary distribution assumption is this git repo skill layout plus the checked-in \u003ccode\u003escripts/okf-loom\u003c/code\u003e helper.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"2-okf-bundle-and-concept-contract\"\u003e2. OKF bundle and concept contract\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAn OKF bundle is a directory tree of Markdown files. Each concept is one non-reserved \u003ccode\u003e.md\u003c/code\u003e file with YAML frontmatter plus a Markdown body. Plain tools can read it, git can diff it, and agents can parse it without an SDK.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eOnly \u003ccode\u003etype\u003c/code\u003e is required by OKF v0.1. okf-loom recommends but does not require \u003ccode\u003etitle\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003edescription\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eresource\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003etags\u003c/code\u003e, and \u003ccode\u003etimestamp\u003c/code\u003e. Unknown frontmatter keys are legal and must be preserved round-trip.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-markdown\"\u003e---\ntype: API Endpoint\ntitle: Create Order\ndescription: POST a new order to the checkout service.\nresource: https://api.example.com/v2/orders\ntags: [checkout, write-api]\ntimestamp: \"2026-06-15T10:00:00Z\"\nrelations:\n  - target: tables/orders\n    type: writes_to\n    detail: idempotent on client_request_id\nentities:\n  - id: entity/order\n    label: Order\n    kind: business_entity\naliases: [purchase, transaction]\ncitations:\n  - id: \"1\"\n    text: Internal data dictionary\n---\n\n# Overview\n\nThis endpoint writes [orders](/tables/orders.md).\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eReserved files keep their upstream meanings. \u003ccode\u003eindex.md\u003c/code\u003e is a directory listing for progressive disclosure. \u003ccode\u003elog.md\u003c/code\u003e is an optional append-only update history. Only the bundle-root \u003ccode\u003eindex.md\u003c/code\u003e may carry frontmatter, and only for \u003ccode\u003eokf_version\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eokf_extensions\u003c/code\u003e, and okf-loom \u003ccode\u003egenerated\u003c/code\u003e marker. Non-root \u003ccode\u003eindex.md\u003c/code\u003e files are pure listings or marker-managed generated regions.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eConcept links may be absolute bundle-relative or relative. Prefer absolute bundle-relative links such as \u003ccode\u003e[orders](/tables/orders.md)\u003c/code\u003e because they remain stable when files move inside subdirectories. Wikilinks such as \u003ccode\u003e[[tables/orders|Orders]]\u003c/code\u003e are accepted as migration/convenience body syntax and resolved into graph edges, but mutators write standard Markdown links.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSee \u003ca href=\"/reference/frontmatter.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003e/reference/frontmatter.md\u003c/a\u003e, \u003ca href=\"/reference/links.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003e/reference/links.md\u003c/a\u003e, and \u003ca href=\"/reference/architecture.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003e/reference/architecture.md\u003c/a\u003e for the detailed reference contracts.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"3-core-runtime-invariants\"\u003e3. Core runtime invariants\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eokf-loom is a Python library and CLI over the same model objects: \u003ccode\u003eBundle\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eConcept\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eLink\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eGraph\u003c/code\u003e, and \u003ccode\u003eContentIndex\u003c/code\u003e. The \u003ccode\u003eContentIndex\u003c/code\u003e is the shared model for graph, search, listings, viewer, and build outputs.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eHard invariants:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eDo not fork the OKF v0.1 wire format.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eDo not introduce hard runtime dependencies beyond okf-loom baseline.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eLoad permissively and preserve unknown data.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eWrite through parse-modify-serialize paths.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eUse atomic writes through temporary file plus rename.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eKeep outputs deterministic; tie-break by concept id where ranking or ordering is otherwise equal.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eKeep machine-readable output JSON-serializable.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eNever overwrite hand-curated \u003ccode\u003eindex.md\u003c/code\u003e or \u003ccode\u003elog.md\u003c/code\u003e content silently.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eWhen a live studio session is attached, concept writes route through the studio write funnel so they are attributed, undoable, logged to the change feed, and broadcast live. Without a live session, mutators use the same data-safety principles through the non-studio atomic write path.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"4-capability-registry-and-governed-extension-keys\"\u003e4. Capability registry and governed extension keys\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe capability registry gives meaning to optional keys without changing the base spec. Bundles opt in by declaring \u003ccode\u003eokf_extensions:\u003c/code\u003e in the bundle-root \u003ccode\u003eindex.md\u003c/code\u003e or by using governed keys that auto-activate the corresponding capability.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe active tier model is:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eTier\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eMeaning\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003ecore\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eAlways active format primitives such as frontmatter, links, indexes, logs, lexical search, graph, backlinks, listings, and mention discovery.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003erecommended\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eShips with okf-loom and requires no plugin or extra.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eoptional\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eRecognised extension surface that may need external provider, plugin, or explicit opt-in.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eCurrent governed top-level keys include \u003ccode\u003erelations\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eentities\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003ealiases\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eprovenance\u003c/code\u003e, and \u003ccode\u003ecitations\u003c/code\u003e. okf-loom intentionally uses top-level governed keys rather than a single nested vendor container. Unknown keys are opaque and preserved.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eExample root declaration:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-yaml\"\u003e---\nokf_version: \"0.1\"\nokf_extensions:\n  - okf.cap.typed_relations\n  - okf.cap.entities\n  - okf.cap.aliases\ngenerated: true\n---\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eRun capability inspection with:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom capabilities\nscripts/okf-loom capabilities --bundle docs-bundle --format json\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSee \u003ca href=\"/reference/capabilities.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003e/reference/capabilities.md\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"5-validation-profiles-and-configuration\"\u003e5. Validation, profiles, and configuration\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eDefault OKF conformance is intentionally small. A bundle is conformant when non-reserved concept files have parseable YAML frontmatter with non-empty \u003ccode\u003etype\u003c/code\u003e, and reserved \u003ccode\u003eindex.md\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003elog.md\u003c/code\u003e files follow their structural rules. Broken links, missing recommended keys, unknown types, and undeclared capabilities are guidance by default.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eValidation profiles:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eProfile\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eBehaviour\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003espec\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eDefault; only hard v0.1 conformance errors fail.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eproducer\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003espec\u003c/code\u003e plus missing recommended concept keys promoted to errors.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eloose\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003ePermissive migration mode; missing \u003ccode\u003etype\u003c/code\u003e becomes a warning.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eUseful validation commands:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom validate docs-bundle\nscripts/okf-loom validate docs-bundle --strict\nscripts/okf-loom validate docs-bundle --profile producer\nscripts/okf-loom validate docs-bundle --fail-on-broken-links\nscripts/okf-loom validate docs-bundle --format json\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ccode\u003eokf-loom.config.yaml\u003c/code\u003e is an optional bundle-root config file. It is additive; absence means defaults. Recognised sections are \u003ccode\u003ebundle\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003eviewer\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003esearch\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003evalidate\u003c/code\u003e, and \u003ccode\u003estudio\u003c/code\u003e. Unknown config keys are preserved in \u003ccode\u003eOkfConfig.raw\u003c/code\u003e for forward compatibility. Path-bearing fields must be bundle-relative and must not escape the bundle root. Boolean and enum values fail closed rather than guessing.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch4 id=\"bundle-scanning-and-exclusions\"\u003eBundle scanning and exclusions\u003c/h4\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eMarkdown discovery (\u003ccode\u003eBundle.load\u003c/code\u003e, the serve watcher, and \u003ccode\u003eokf import\u003c/code\u003e) walks the bundle tree top-down and prunes excluded directories rather than rglob-scanning everything, so a bundle root that is also a real workspace root does not sweep \u003ccode\u003enode_modules\u003c/code\u003e, nested cloned repos, or virtualenv trees in as thousands of missing-\u003ccode\u003etype\u003c/code\u003e pseudo-concepts.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThree exclusion rule groups apply; a match in a later group overrides earlier ones, and within a group the last matching rule wins (git semantics):\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col\u003e\u003cli\u003eBuilt-in defaults: hidden directories (\u003ccode\u003e.git\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003e.okf-loom\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003e.venv\u003c/code\u003e, …), \u003ccode\u003enode_modules/\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003e__pycache__/\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003evenv/\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003ebower_components/\u003c/code\u003e. Hidden \u003cem\u003efiles\u003c/em\u003e still load — only hidden directories are pruned. Additionally, any non-root directory containing a \u003ccode\u003e.git\u003c/code\u003e entry (a nested cloned repo, submodule, or worktree) is pruned — a structural rule, overridable only by \u003ccode\u003ebundle.include\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003e.gitignore\u003c/code\u003e rules — the bundle root's file and nested ones, each scoped to its own directory — unless \u003ccode\u003ebundle.respect_gitignore: false\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003ccode\u003ebundle.exclude\u003c/code\u003e patterns from \u003ccode\u003eokf-loom.config.yaml\u003c/code\u003e (a negation such as \u003ccode\u003e\"!.docs/\"\u003c/code\u003e re-includes a path the defaults or a \u003ccode\u003e.gitignore\u003c/code\u003e excluded, with git's limitation: not from under a pruned directory).\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAbove all exclusions sit \u003ccode\u003ebundle.include\u003c/code\u003e patterns — the explicit add-back lever. Include beats every exclusion source, including the structural nested-repo rule, and CAN reach inside pruned directories. Two forms:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul\u003e\u003cli\u003eDirectory form (\u003ccode\u003e\"vendor-repo/\"\u003c/code\u003e, or a wildcard-free path like \u003ccode\u003e\"node_modules/my-pkg/docs\"\u003c/code\u003e): the directory is revived — the scanner descends its ancestors just far enough to reach it, then scans the subtree as normal bundle content. Exclusion rules that were overridden at the revived directory (an anchored \u003ccode\u003enode_modules/**\u003c/code\u003e in a \u003ccode\u003e.gitignore\u003c/code\u003e, a \u003ccode\u003ebundle.exclude\u003c/code\u003e that killed it) stay overridden for its contents, while unrelated rules — the hidden-dir default, basename rules like \u003ccode\u003e*.tmp.md\u003c/code\u003e, excludes targeting deeper paths — keep applying inside. This is the recommended form.\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003eGlob form (\u003ccode\u003e\"vendor-repo/**\"\u003c/code\u003e): force-includes exactly what it matches, everything beneath — defaults included. A broad \u003ccode\u003e**\u003c/code\u003e on a huge tree is a deliberate, paid-for traversal.\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eInclude patterns without a \u003ccode\u003e/\u003c/code\u003e (basename form) apply wherever the scan already reaches but never open pruned directories — pulling something out of a pruned tree requires naming its path. Include patterns are positive only; a \u003ccode\u003e!\u003c/code\u003e there is rejected fail-closed.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003ePatterns use the practical gitignore subset: \u003ccode\u003e*\u003c/code\u003e, \u003ccode\u003e?\u003c/code\u003e, and character classes never cross \u003ccode\u003e/\u003c/code\u003e; \u003ccode\u003e**\u003c/code\u003e spans path segments; a trailing \u003ccode\u003e/\u003c/code\u003e makes a rule directory-only; a \u003ccode\u003e/\u003c/code\u003e anywhere else anchors it to the rule's base directory; leading \u003ccode\u003e!\u003c/code\u003e negates (exclusion groups only). Scanning stays deterministic (name-sorted per directory) and never follows symlinked directories. An unparseable config keeps the bundle loadable: loading warns (\u003ccode\u003econfig.unparseable\u003c/code\u003e) and scans with the built-in defaults.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eSee \u003ca href=\"/reference/config_yaml.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003e/reference/config_yaml.md\u003c/a\u003e and \u003ca href=\"/how-to/validate_in_ci.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003e/how-to/validate_in_ci.md\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"6-search-modes-and-zero-dependency-retrieval\"\u003e6. Search modes and zero-dependency retrieval\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe current shipped search story is dependency-free. Do not describe dense embeddings, vector indexes, SQLite FTS provider flags, provider config keys, or semantic/LLM package extras as shipped current behavior.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe six current modes are:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ctable class=\"okf-table\"\u003e\n\u003cthead\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003cth\u003eMode\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eBackend / source\u003c/th\u003e\u003cth\u003eNotes\u003c/th\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/thead\u003e\n\u003ctbody\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003elexical\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eLexicalBackend\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eDefault BM25-style field-weighted keyword search.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003etag\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eLexicalBackend\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eCase-insensitive tag membership.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003esemantic\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eSemanticLiteBackend\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eFuzzy-semantic token + character-trigram cosine; not embeddings.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003ehybrid\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eHybridBackend\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eReciprocal Rank Fusion of lexical and SemanticLite.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003eentity\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eIn-module entity matcher\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eMatches concept ids, titles, descriptions, entity labels, and aliases.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003ctr\u003e\u003ctd\u003e\u003ccode\u003erelation\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eIn-module relation/edge filter\u003c/td\u003e\u003ctd\u003eFilters \u003ccode\u003erelations:\u003c/code\u003e and Markdown graph edges by relation/source/target.\u003c/td\u003e\u003c/tr\u003e\n\u003c/tbody\u003e\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eExamples:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom search docs-bundle \"comment lifecycle\"\nscripts/okf-loom search docs-bundle \"agent loop\" --mode semantic\nscripts/okf-loom search docs-bundle \"studio\" --mode hybrid\nscripts/okf-loom search docs-bundle \"#reference\" --mode tag\nscripts/okf-loom search docs-bundle \"\" --mode relation --relation depends_on\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe HTTP \u003ccode\u003e/__search\u003c/code\u003e route uses lexical search with a server-side limit. Use the CLI for the other modes. See \u003ca href=\"/reference/search_modes.md\" class=\"okf-internal\"\u003e/reference/search_modes.md\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"7-discovery-planning-update-repair-and-authoring-verbs\"\u003e7. Discovery, planning, update, repair, and authoring verbs\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eokf-loom supports both report-oriented and action-oriented workflows. \u003ccode\u003ediscover\u003c/code\u003e finds gaps and suggestions. \u003ccode\u003eplan\u003c/code\u003e builds a reviewable action envelope. \u003ccode\u003eupdate\u003c/code\u003e applies an update plan or action envelope idempotently. \u003ccode\u003erepair\u003c/code\u003e applies mechanical fixes such as marker-safe index regeneration and typed-relation mirroring.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom discover docs-bundle --out /tmp/okf-suggestions.json\nscripts/okf-loom plan docs-bundle --out /tmp/okf-plan.json\nscripts/okf-loom update docs-bundle --plan /tmp/okf-plan.json --dry-run\nscripts/okf-loom repair docs-bundle --indexes --dry-run\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eScoped work is supported for fast agent loops:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom plan docs-bundle --scope reference/spec --neighbors --out /tmp/scoped-plan.json\nscripts/okf-loom update docs-bundle --plan /tmp/scoped-plan.json\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAuthoring verbs are direct, safe mutators:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cpre\u003e\u003ccode class=\"language-bash\"\u003escripts/okf-loom write-concept --bundle docs-bundle --id reference/new_topic --type Reference --title \"New Topic\"\nscripts/okf-loom set-frontmatter --bundle docs-bundle --id reference/new_topic --key tags --json-value '[\"reference\"]'\nscripts/okf-loom link-add --bundle docs-bundle --source reference/new_topic --target reference/spec --label \"current spec\"\nscripts/okf-loom entity-add --bundle docs-bundle --id reference/new_topic --label \"okf-loom\" --kind Product\nscripts/okf-loom update-section --bundle docs-bundle --id reference/new_topic --heading \"## Usage\" --body-file /tmp/frag.md\nscripts/okf-loom replace-text --bundle docs-bundle --id reference/new_topic --old \"exact old text\" --new \"exact new text\"\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ccode\u003elink-add\u003c/code\u003e is fail-closed on missing targets unless \u003ccode\u003e--allow-forward-reference\u003c/code\u003e is passed intentionally. Repeated actions should converge to no-op or already-present results rather than duplicate content.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003ePartial body updates are first-class: \u003ccode\u003eupdate-section\u003c/code\u003e replaces (or, with \u003ccode\u003e--append\u003c/code\u003e, appends to) exactly one section — matched by heading text, optionally level-pinned (\u003ccode\u003e\"## Banking\"\u003c/code\u003e), including its subsections — and \u003ccode\u003ereplace-text\u003c/code\u003e applies an exact textual patch. Both mutate only the body, fail closed on a missing target (\u003ccode\u003esection_not_found\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003etext_not_found\u003c/code\u003e) and on ambiguity (\u003ccode\u003esection_ambiguous:N\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003etext_ambiguous:N\u003c/code\u003e), and are available as \u003ccode\u003e/__apply\u003c/code\u003e op kinds \u003ccode\u003eupdate_section\u003c/code\u003e / \u003ccode\u003ereplace_text\u003c/code\u003e. An agent should never need to reconstruct a whole document (or stage a copy) to change one block.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ccode\u003ewrite-concept\u003c/code\u003e CREATE fills the mechanically derivable recommended keys by default so a fresh concept passes \u003ccode\u003evalidate --strict\u003c/code\u003e without follow-up \u003ccode\u003eset-frontmatter\u003c/code\u003e calls: \u003ccode\u003eresource\u003c/code\u003e defaults to the bundle-absolute concept path and \u003ccode\u003etimestamp\u003c/code\u003e to the current UTC instant. Explicit values win; UPDATE never injects defaults; \u003ccode\u003e--no-defaults\u003c/code\u003e opts out. Content keys (title, description, tags) are never auto-invented.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"8-indexes-logs-scaffolding-and-derived-artifacts\"\u003e8. Indexes, logs, scaffolding, and derived artifacts\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003ccode\u003eindex\u003c/code\u003e regenerates directory listings without clobbering hand-authored content.
